source: Measurements reported by the initial Vercel Linux build resource probe

measurements.scope: Tiled audio and the original transcript exercise full-pipeline resources only; this is not speech-accuracy validation.

failure_reason: The 60-second worker completed but exceeded the conservative 1900 MiB build gate. This is a gate failure, not an observed out-of-memory crash.

decision.validation_required: A new isolated 30-second stress pair must pass the unchanged 1900 MiB gate before deployment.

scope: Compact transcription of observed build measurements. Linux build-host timing and memory do not guarantee function-runtime behavior or general speech accuracy.
